scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.sync: git switch main && git pull && node scripts/install-if-changed.mjs && docker compose up -d --wait && npm run migration:run -w backend
scripts.sync:branch: git fetch origin && git merge --no-commit origin/main && node scripts/install-if-changed.mjs && docker compose up -d --wait && npm run migration:run -w backend
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check -w frontend && npm run build
